what: Fixed full-observation teachers of the response/latent consistency arms (B01 <- TEACH0, B11 <- TEACH1)
rule: a teacher is fitted on exactly the fitting drugs of its student (asserted in train.py), on fit_input control cells at p = 1 only; it never sees an evaluation drug's treated cells, eval_input cells, or reference cells as input; its output is detached and never replaces the measured target

dev.evaluated_on: dev fold 2 (79 train drug groups); used to pick the teacher learning rate and for the teacher gate

cost: teacher training is counted in the total compute (one teacher run per student run)
